summary: A titled part of a page. Boxed (the default): a bordered surface whose head is a bar of its own, its title set like a table's column heads. Flat: a heading over a rule with the content on the page's own ground. Either takes a count or fact beside the title, a description under it and actions at the head's end; a tone draws the body as a graph's dot grid or marks the section critical.

sokkel-ui-egui: crates/core/src/widgets/display.rs (Card with bar: no Section yet)

anatomy.box: The boxed variant's surface: the card's ground inside a 1px edge, rounded as a surface, clipping its content to its corners.
anatomy.head: The boxed variant's head bar across the box's top, on the section heads' ground over their rule: the mark, the title with its meta, the description under them, and the actions at its end. At least as tall as a listing's head row; it grows to hold a description.
anatomy.flatHead: The flat variant's heading line over a rule, on the page's own ground, with no inset of its own: the same pieces as the boxed head.
anatomy.mark: With tone critical: a warning mark before the title.
anatomy.title: The section's heading, an h2 cut short on one line. In the boxed head it is set like a table's column heads in the text color, but in its own case, so it can hold a name such as a job's; the section is labelled by it.
anatomy.flatTitle: The flat head's title, set as a section title.
anatomy.meta: A count or a short fact beside the title, 8 after it, quieter than it, drawn as a page header's count is (parts/page-header); it drops under the title when both do not fit, cut short past that.
anatomy.description: A sentence under the title saying what the section holds; the head grows to hold it.
anatomy.actions: Controls at the head's end. They go under the title when they would leave it less than its room, and wrap from the end when wider than the head.
anatomy.body: The section's content: padded in the box unless flush; on the page's ground under the flat head, a section gap below it. With fill the box takes the height it is given and the body scrolls within it.

meta.does: A count or a short fact beside the title, drawn quieter than it.

description.does: A sentence under the title: what this part of the page holds.

variant.does: boxed: a bordered surface with a head bar of its own. flat: a heading over a rule with the content on the page's own ground, for the rare page that wants it.

tone.does: graph: the body on a graph canvas's dot grid, for a drawing with no ground of its own. critical: a rule in the critical tone (across the box's top, or under the flat head) and a warning mark before the title.

headingId.does: The heading's id, for something else to point at; the section is labelled by its heading either way.

flush.does: The body takes no padding, for content that fills the box to its edges, such as a list or a graph.

fill.does: The box takes the height its container gives it and its body scrolls within it, as an editor or a preview wants.

head.note: At least this tall: the mark, the title's column and the actions centered in it. The same height as a listing's head row.

describedHead.note: With a description: the head grows to hold it, padded 8 down and up, its pieces set at the top.

flatHead.note: At least this tall, with no inset: on the page's own edge.

titleLine.note: The title's column, padded 4 down and up when there is no description.

flatGap.note: Between the flat head and its content.

titleMetaGap.note: Between the title and its meta.

titleBasis.note: The actions stay beside the title while it keeps this or its own width, and go under it otherwise.

metaBasis.note: The meta stays beside the title while the title keeps this or its own width, and drops under it otherwise.

criticalRule.note: The critical rule across the box's top.

graphGrid.note: The dot grid's step: a dot every 18 both ways, centered on the body.

rest.means: A titled part of the page, its body drawn.

described.means: With a description: the head grows to hold it, its pieces set at the top.

toneCritical.means: Something here went wrong: a rule in the critical tone (2 wide across the box's top, or the flat head's own rule) and a warning mark before the title.

toneGraph.means: The body is a graph canvas's dot grid, for a drawing with no ground of its own; under a flat head it is rounded as a surface.

fill.means: The box takes the height its container gives it, and its body scrolls within it.

toneCritical.note: 2 wide across the box's top only; the rest of the edge stays.

rest.note: The rule is under the bar, 1 wide.
The rule is under the heading line, 1 wide.
In typeface-heading; the table head's size, weight and tracking, never its case (table-head-transform): the title keeps its own.
In the body face with tabular figures, as a page header's count. The code face is for codes.
On the box's ground, or under a flat head on the page's.

toneGraph.note: The dots: one every 18, 1 in radius. Under a flat head the grid is rounded radius-surface.

appText.title: Each section's title, its meta and its description.
appText.actions: The head's actions, which follow their context: in a Runs section, Retry failed rather than Retry failed runs.

sokkel-ui: A section element labelled by its heading (aria-labelledby), whose id is headingId or one of its own.
The box clips its content to its corners (overflow-hidden).
The head is PaneHeader: variant panel in the box, plain with inset false under a flat section. Its pieces wrap by flex basis, with no width the part measures.
className and bodyClassName lay the section and its body out in their container.
Surface, beside Section in the same module, is the bordered surface with no heading of its own, for content that is a surface under a flat heading.
sokkel-ui-egui: There is no Section yet: Card with bar(true) is the nearest, a box with the section heads' bar and its title.

drift.spec: density.panel-pad (12, 8 compact) across the head and round the body.
drift.today: As of dfb6079 (display.rs unchanged since b73200b): Card pads the head's title 16 and its body 16 at both densities.

drift.spec: In the head under the title, in text.help; the head grows to hold it.
drift.today: Card draws it in the body, in text.body.

As of dfb6079 there is no Section. Card with bar(true) draws the boxed head: density.panel-head tall, section-head-ground over a section-head-line rule, the title in text.head and section-head-ink (else card-foreground, which is foreground in every theme), cut short. Not yet: the flat variant, the meta, the actions, the tones critical and graph, flush, fill, and the head growing to hold a description.
